title: VWFS Agency Approval – Checks, Declines & Process
tags: Agency Approval, VWFS, VU3, Connect OnLine, COL, SLI, PCP, CUPRA
body:
Agency Approval is triggered when a vehicle reaches physical status code 38/40. Use this checklist to reduce avoidable declines and understand what happens next.

## 1. Check the VU3 contract
- The correct VWFS proposal number is entered in the Contract tab.
- Invoiced to is set to Volkswagen Financial Services (UK) Ltd.
- The contract has been printed and Create Finance Record has been clicked.
- The contract status shows Contract Live.

## 2. Check SLI and vehicle details
- The vehicle is tagged to the correct customer.
- The vehicle is marked as PCP – M4.
- If the vehicle was tagged manually, check the SLI order number, VIN and registration number in the VU3 Order and Payment tab.
- Check that the VIN matches Connect OnLine (COL) and that the chassis number is correct in COL.

Note: The SLI robot normally tags the vehicle automatically unless it is in negotiated stock at your site or another retailer's site.

## 3. Make sure the finance figures match
The figures in VU3 must match those in Connect OnLine:
- Invoice price.
- Part-exchange contribution.
- VWFS settlement amount, if applicable.
- Customer deposit.
- Cash deposit.
- Financial deposit contribution, if the CUPRA finance offer includes one.

Where to enter the figures:
- Part-exchange and VWFS settlement amounts: Offer tab, Trade-in details.
- Customer cash contribution: Contract tab.
- Financial deposit contribution: Contract tab.

The agent is responsible for checking the figures. VWFS New Business can identify a discrepancy but cannot advise which figures need changing.

## 4. Agency Approval timeline
### Day 1 – Initial checks
The agent ensures the VU3 and COL data match. The BI data extract then updates VU3.

### Day 2 – First approval review
- Morning: Brand sends the approval template to VWFS.
- Afternoon: VWFS returns the file to Brand, and the file is automatically sent to CSC.
- CSC removes blocks from approved orders.
- If an order is declined, CSC contacts the agent to explain that it needs correcting.

### Day 2 onwards – Correcting a declined order
Check the decline notes in COL, correct the relevant details in VU3, SLI or COL, and amend the order as needed.

### Day 3–4 – Resubmission
Corrected orders are sent to VWFS in the next reporting run. When approved, CSC removes the blocks and the agent can proceed to print documents in COL.

CUPRA UK reporting runs take place on Monday, Wednesday and Friday. VWFS normally approves or declines orders within 48 hours, based on the correct information being supplied.

## 5. If the order is declined
1. Read the decline notes in Connect OnLine.
2. Recheck the invoiced-to party, Contract Live status, VWFS proposal number, SLI order number, VIN/chassis number and finance figures.
3. Correct the relevant details in VU3, SLI or COL.
4. Allow for the next reporting run and VWFS review.
5. Once approved and unblocked, proceed with printing documents in COL.

## Quick reminder
The common causes of decline are an incorrect invoiced-to party, missing or incorrect order/VIN details, mismatched finance figures, or documents being sent before Agency Approval. Always check the decline notes first and plan ahead for the customer's handover.
